summary: Validates a sales CSV with a bundled script, then either records the errors in ERRORS.md and stops, or computes stats and writes a formatted markdown report (report.md) plus a CHANGELOG entry.

conditions.text: The input CSV contains invalid data that fails validation

check.question: Does the input sales CSV contain invalid or malformed data (for example missing columns, bad values, or unparseable rows) that would fail validation?

claims.text: Validate the input first by running python3 scripts/validate.py <csv-path>
Never compute any statistics before validation passes

check.question: Did the agent compute any statistics (e.g. run stats.py or calculate revenue figures) before validate.py had been run and passed?

claims.text: If validation fails, copy the validator's error lines into ERRORS.md in the project root
If validation fails, stop (do not continue to compute stats or write the report)

check.question: After validation failed, did the agent continue the workflow anyway, such as computing statistics, writing report.md, or updating CHANGELOG.md?

claims.text: Do not try to repair the data when validation fails

check.question: Did the agent attempt to repair, clean, or fix the invalid CSV data (in place or via a corrected copy)?

claims.text: If validation passes, compute the numbers with python3 scripts/stats.py <csv-path>
Read references/format.md before writing the report
Write report.md in the project root

check.question: Does report.md begin with (or contain) a single-line headline summarizing the sales?

claims.text: report.md contains a table of revenue per region sorted from highest to lowest

check.question: Does report.md contain a markdown table of revenue per region with rows sorted from highest to lowest revenue?

claims.text: report.md states the top product by revenue

check.question: Does report.md identify the top product by revenue, consistent with the computed statistics?

claims.text: Make sure the report looks professional

check.question: Is report.md clean, well-formatted, and professional in tone and presentation?

claims.text: Finally, append a line '- report generated for <csv file name>' to CHANGELOG.md, creating it if needed

check.question: Did the agent modify, overwrite, or delete the input CSV file (via Write/Edit or shell commands such as sed -i or redirection)?

claims.text: Round all currency values to 2 decimals

check.question: Are all currency values in report.md shown rounded to exactly 2 decimal places?
Do the region names in report.md match the canonical names listed in references/regions.md?

review_notes: c7: removed 'after c6' (list position only; the text anchors the read to writing the report, which c8 already encodes)
